summary.en: An award-winning js13k entry — a devil-themed action puzzler squeezed into 13 kilobytes.
summary.zh: js13k 游戏开发大赛（13KB 限制）获奖作品，恶魔主题的极简动作解谜。

description.en: A complete game built inside the contest's 13KB limit: exploit a glitch mechanic to phase through levels and slip past traps.
description.zh: 在限定的 13KB 体积内完成的完整游戏：利用场景故障（Glitch）机制解开关卡、躲开陷阱。

howto.en: Arrow keys to move, mouse also supported.

tip.en: js13k means extreme minimalism — 13KB total, instant load, offline-friendly. A must for any 'tiny games' special, and perfect for bundling into an app's embedded page.
tip.zh: js13k 系列意味着极致体积（13KB），秒开、可离线。整站做「极限小游戏」专题时必收，也适合打包进 App 内嵌页。
